Mei is a female researcher who develops bodysuits and portable weapons at a research institute funded by the UFS.



Personality
She views her own purpose to use her talent to create a weapon against demons and securing a budget for the development of anti-demon weapons.

Often unable to understand the consequences of her actions like attacking a group of orcs and losing, will just make her think about modifications of her weapon system not her own safety and overall she is rather uncaring about herself.

Appearance
She has short brown hair and brown eyes.

History
Background
From an early age, she was educated at a facility in the United States.

She has an extraordinary talent in weapons development and a genius in operation. May goes to the battlefield with her own prototype weapons and suits to collect more accurate data. Her "Full Roast Cannon" is a weapon for burying demons with human power. It was created with the concept of compressing energy and destroying the cells themselves. However, fuel economy is poor, and if you shoot three times, you will run out of energy. Use this powerful weapon in humans I am wearing a special suit as a control device for this, but since there are only those that match the size of Mei, Currently, only Mei can handle this weapon.

Timeline TABA
Attacked a group of Orcs of Fuuma Kotaro (TABA) and is punished for the dead orcs, a second event shows that she still has not broken and worries still about her weapon system not being strong enough.

Timeline RPGX
Appeared on the island of Ame-no-Uzume and took part in the dancing festival, together with the Independent Commando Unit.


Powers/Abilities
Main Weapon: Full Roast Cannon

Experimental Cannon User: compressing energy and destroying the cells of demons but costs a lot of energy, only three shots can be fired.
